items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: I work with Paul Barberand. I've been all around the country with Paul Barberand... I played at New Orleans Country Club with Paul.

ctx.x: You understand what I'm talking about?

They ain't got to give you a glass of water. You understand? Them people is paying you to play. Now if they want to give you water, they give you water. You understand what I mean? They feel like giving you water, they give you water. Before I make the people give you nothing, them people ain't supposed to give you nothing. They ain't supposed to give you nothing. What you got some fellas playing, they're talking, man, why don't you ask a man to give me a bottle, can't get us a drink. You know what I tell them? I…

They be expecting you to make the people give you something, which you cannot. Now sometimes, you play for the people and they're hungry. You need to ask people to make the sandwich. Well, I feel embarrassed to be asking people about something easy. See, I always get up. It's supposed to tell me, no, I can't get mad. You know what, I'm charging enough to get you on your own lunch. Now if you give me something, I'll appreciate it. If you don't give me nothing, it's alright, it's the same with me. When I knock off,…
